findings.observation: The first page explicitly displays Final volume: 1003 ml. This supplies a source denominator for this base formulation only.

Strain instructions distinguish DSM 16643 (vitamin/DTT/coenzyme M supplementation and omission of sulfide/cysteine) from DSM 16632 (replace sludge with rumen fluid plus Trypticase and Wolin vitamins). Do not conflate the two into a single current DSMZ variant.
DSM 6216: Na-acetate increased to 3.00 g/l. DSM 15163: 0.3 g DL-dithiothreitol, omit sodium sulfide, final pH 6.0. These differ from captured KOMODO rows.

Fatty-acid inputs are ml, including DL-2-methylbutyric acid 27.00 ml; titrate stock with concentrated NaOH. SL-10 explicitly makes up to 1000.00 ml. Ferrous sulfate stock is 1.00 g in 1000.00 ml 0.1 N sulfuric acid and should be freshly prepared.
200.00 ml clarified rumen fluid, 780.00 ml water, 4.00 g bicarbonate, distinct rumen preparation; no displayed final-volume statement. SL-10 make-up and liquid fatty-acid units visible.
Includes 1.00 ml selenite-tungstate solution, 10.00 ml methanol (15% v/v), 1.00 g bicarbonate, 940.00 ml input water and final pH check 7.6. SL-10 table spans both pages; all rows are visible.
